tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Neon orange from the brand guidelines. The source for accent. Fills and large marks only; small orange text uses text-accent.

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Space black from the brand guidelines. The canvas and text on accent fills.

tokens.name: brand-gray
tokens.usage: Light gray from the brand guidelines. Studio text-secondary.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: White from the brand guidelines. Logo ink on dark grounds.

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. App shell main area and marketing pages.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table rows, sidebar, open workbench tab. The default ground for content.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: A block inside a surface: a selected segment, a nested group, artwork placeholders.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, the command bar, tab strip, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Drawers, dialogs, menus, toasts. Always with shadow-overlay.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, ghost buttons, menu items and tabs.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Fill for a selected choice card, the playing row and the current tab marker area. Pair with a border or icon, never on its own.

tokens.name: bg-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and the mobile drawer.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, body copy, values. Reads on every bg- token.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, artist names, descriptions. Reads on every bg- token.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, timestamps, captions, placeholder-like meta. Reads on every bg- token.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels. Raised to 3:1 or more on every bg- token (was 2.4 to 2.8:1): WCAG exempts disabled controls, but a label people cannot read cannot explain itself. Always paired with a reason (aria-disabled plus a message) or a disabled cursor.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Small orange text: the active nav label, inline links in product copy. Reads on every bg- token.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover fills (5.5:1 and 6.2:1).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows inside one card. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Card and panel edges, section dividers. Decorative: the content inside identifies the card.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of things you can operate: inputs, secondary buttons, switches, choice cards, checkboxes. 3:1 or more on every bg- token.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover edge of a control or card.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one primary action per view, the selected choice edge, the playing indicator, the current loop step. Nothing else.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button. The change is a lighter fill plus the pointer; never the only signal of state.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every focusable element. 3:1 or more on every bg- token in both themes.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Keep, Ready, Saved. Teal, off the red-green axis, always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Maybe, Queued, limits close. Always with a clock icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Failed, errors, destructive actions. Always with an alert icon and a word. Never used for Pass.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Analysing, processing, neutral notices. Always with a word.

tokens.name: tool-ink
tokens.usage: Glyph colour inside a tool icon tile (data-1 to data-5 fills): brand black.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Series 1: energy, the reference track in comparisons. Chart marks only (3:1 or more on bg-surface); label values with text- tokens, never in this colour.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Series 2: the candidate track, tempo. Chart marks only (3:1 or more on bg-surface); label values with text- tokens, never in this colour.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Series 3: key, harmonic content. Chart marks only (3:1 or more on bg-surface); label values with text- tokens, never in this colour.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Series 4: mood or texture. Chart marks only (3:1 or more on bg-surface); label values with text- tokens, never in this colour.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Series 5: everything else. Chart marks only (3:1 or more on bg-surface); label values with text- tokens, never in this colour.

color.note: Studio (dark) is the only theme. Daylight was retired on 8 November 2026: every Resomix surface, the marketing site included, is dark.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per view: the page or tab title.

styles.name: section-title
styles.sample: Pick up where you left off

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card, drawer and dialog titles; track titles in rows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Start from a track you love. We find tracks that sound like it.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines, artist names, descriptions in dense lists.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, button text in small buttons, tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The smallest text in the product. Timestamps and hints. Nothing smaller.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: The number in a stat tile.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: BPM, key, duration, match score in rows. Numbers only, sentence case units.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero headline only, one per page. Benzin. The only style that may be set in capitals. 40px under 1024px.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Closing banner or one feature headline per page. Benzin, sentence case. 32px under 1024px.

styles.name: marketing-h2
styles.usage: Section headings on landing pages, in sentence case. 26px under 1024px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Drop in a track and hear what sounds like it in seconds.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero or section heading. Max 2 lines, max width reading-max. 17px under 1024px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; icon to text in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of small cards, row cell gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a view.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in a view; page side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding of a view under the tab strip.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between landing page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gap between landing page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard hints, small tags, checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs, segmented control items, artwork thumbnails in rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, choice cards, menus, the command bar, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Drawers, dialogs, large panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Marketing tiles and product frames (the brand's rounded-square tile).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and switch tracks only.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Drawers, dialogs, menus, toasts, the open command bar. Nothing on the page itself has a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The selected item in a segmented control and a dragged row.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, row actions, triage buttons in dense lists.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, tabs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The primary action of a view and the main search field.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest pointer target (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8). Icon buttons pad up to it.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: App sidebar, expanded. Collapsed: 64px.

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: Track and crate drawers on desktop. Full width under 720px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of view content and landing sections.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of paragraphs.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Tabs, segmented control, disclosure open.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Drawers and dialogs entering.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Every transition. With prefers-reduced-motion, durations go to 0.
